result.description:
All Industries Group is a family owned and run manufacturing business on the central coast of Yeppoon, Qld. The All Industries Group team is built with the most experienced, skillful, and committed employees, and is the largest manufacturing company in Livingstone Shire.

All Industries strives to set the standard of what quality looks like in the advanced manufacturing space, through our systems and culture. All Industries is dedicated to ensuring the business is run with it's employees in mind. This is accomplished through our core values which are at the centre of everything we do. These include Quality, Teamwork, Family, Integrity, and Education.

We are seeking experienced PAINTERS to join our busy workshop.

To be successful in this position, you should ideally be:
Competent in using wide range of painting equipment
Experienced in coating applications (Brush and Roller)
Able to utilise different painting techniques based on the nature of the surface
Able to use viscosity cups and thickness gauges to measure the amount of paint to be used and the texture of the paint
Painting small items and doing touch-ups
Understand surface preparation and finishes.
Be able to understand and complete works to specifications.
Be able to mix to correct ratio two-part paint coatings etc.
Select paints, varnishes and stains to various surfaces using brushes, sprays, and rollers.
Understand the use of Wet Film Thickness Gauges and be able to achieve specified dry film thickness.
Be able to work at heights and in confined spaces.
Erecting scaffolding and ladders.
Completes quality checks for conformity with established operational standards
Quality control and quality assessments are followed and implemented
Ensuring that high safety standards are met including use of safety equipment
Cleaning equipment and work areas.
Safely disposing of chemical waste
Record and identify any product, process, environment, safety or quality problems
Take the necessary action to secure the safety of the work area if compromised
Participate and add value to the company’s visions and business development

Desirable tickets:
At least 3-years of experience and has trade qualification
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics
High-Risk License
Working at Heights and confined spaces
White Card
Drivers Licence
First Fire Attack

If you feel you are the right person for the role, please provide a personalised cover letter summarising your experience and why you would like to work for All Industries Group.

All Industries Group is an equal opportunity company and invite applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply, particularly women and persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Summary of role requirements:
Looking for candidates available to work on weekdays
2-3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
Working rights required for this role
